question: The hypotenuse of a right - angled isosceles triangle is 25{ sqrt{2}}cm long. what is the area of triangle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an isosceles right-angled triangle, the area can be calculated directly using its hypotenuse.

⇒ Area = (Hypotenuse)² ÷ 4

⇒ Area = (25√2)² ÷ 4

⇒ Area = (625 × 2) ÷ 4

⇒ Area = 1250 ÷ 4 = 312.5

**∴ The correct answer is 312.5 sq. cm.**
